title: List the full names of superheroes who have a Strength attribute value grea
question: List the full names of superheroes who have a Strength attribute value greater than the average Strength attribute value among all heroes with a Durability attribute value below 60.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_020"
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1."XCL_018" = T2."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2."XCL_010" = T3."XCL_003"
WHERE T3."XCL_004" = 'Strength'
  AND T2."XCL_011" > (
    SELECT AVG(S."XCL_011")
    FROM hero_attribute AS S
    INNER JOIN attribute AS SA ON S."XCL_010" = SA."XCL_003"
    WHERE SA."XCL_004" = 'Strength'
      AND S."XCL_009" IN (
        SELECT D."XCL_009"
        FROM hero_attribute AS D
        INNER JOIN attribute AS DA ON D."XCL_010" = DA."XCL_003"
        WHERE DA."XCL_004" = 'Durability' AND D."XCL_011" < 60
      )
  )

SELECT T1."XCL_020"
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1."XCL_018" = T2."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2."XCL_010" = T3."XCL_003"
WHERE T3."XCL_004" = 'Strength'
  AND T2."XCL_011" > (
    SELECT AVG(S."XCL_011")
    FROM hero_attribute AS S
    INNER JOIN attribute AS SA ON S."XCL_010" = SA."XCL_003"
    WHERE SA."XCL_004" = 'Strength'
      AND S."XCL_009" IN (
        SELECT D."XCL_009"
        FROM hero_attribute AS D
        INNER JOIN attribute AS DA ON D."XCL_010" = DA."XCL_003"
        WHERE DA."XCL_004" = 'Durability' AND D."XCL_011" < 60
      )
  )
